# How many `tests/test_*.py` files this repository tracks.
#
# Cross-leg agreement catches a suite LOST on one leg, because the legs then
# disagree. It cannot catch a file deleted everywhere at once: every leg
# collects the same smaller number and the run is green. This integer is the
# other half - removing a suite fails CI until the removal is declared here,
# in the same commit, where a reviewer sees it.
#
# Adding tests to an existing file changes nothing. Only adding or removing a
# FILE touches this line, which is rare and always deliberate.
181
